name: Owen
title: Owner / Operator
emotionalDrivers: This person has an increased exposure to personal liability, and their reputation is also on the line if they encounter any major concerns over quality or compliance.

This person desires to feel sophisticated about technology choices as it drives business differentiation.

challenges: Inability to scale/grow business.

Increase employee satisfaction and retention.
Increase resident satisfaction and retention.
Build a valuable brand.
solutionPriorities: Must meet needs cross-departmentally - not just for training but also for HR, Accounting, Finance, etc.

High cost of multiple solutions from multiple vendors.
Wish to reduce tech stack and combine solutions where possible.

buyingRole: SMB (up to 5k units) — Decision-Maker: Flatter organization means he’s involved in too many decisions. May lose focus. caresAbout: Confidence in portfolio direction, early visibility into risk and opportunity, performance that scales through change.
